Concept Solutions, LLC is hiring an Associate Software Engineer to support a Department of War customer’s application modernization program. The role focuses on troubleshooting and testing Go and React/TypeScript applications, supporting releases and ongoing sustainment, and collaborating with senior engineers on production issues.
Information Technology
Software
Information Services
No H1B

Responsibilities
Troubleshoot and resolve software defects in applications developed using Go and React/TypeScript under the guidance of senior engineers
Develop, execute, and maintain software tests to support application quality and reliability
Participate in application patching cycles, software releases, and ongoing sustainment activities
Collaborate with senior engineers and team members to support production applications and resolve technical issues
Gradually transition into the team's on-call support rotation following onboarding and training
